subject: Java8 dependency to use Renjin in my java application on Mac OS

messages.author: e5cec4dbfda364db
messages.subject: Java8 dependency to use Renjin in my java application on Mac OS
parts:
Hi,

I am running a Java framework called Field (https://github.com/OpenEndedGroup/Field) and have been looking at adding Renjin in order to combine the amazing graphics capabilities of Field together with the beauty of R. Field is running Jython as the main language, but also supports the use of methods written in Java, JRuby, Clojure etc.

The problem I am facing is that I can't seem to get Renjin to get recognized by the ScriptEngineManager when I run Java7, i.e. the following code results in engine being null.
ScriptEngineManager manager = new ScriptEngineManager();
ScriptEngine engine = manager.getEngineByName("Renjin");
However, when I switch to Java8, the ScriptEngineManager recognizes Renjin and all goes well.

The problem is that Field runs well with Java7, the support for combining Java methods and Jython breaks.

I am running Mac OS X Yosemite and I have built Renjin using the latest instructions for Mac OS in building.md that was updated two days ago.

Anyone who have got some idea of how to get Renjin to run on Java7 in my application? When running a stand-alone application in Eclipse it seems to go well, which is sort of puzzling.

Best regards
Johan

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Java8 dependency to use Renjin in my java application on Mac OS
parts:
Hi Johan,
Sounds super interesting,

I've had no problems with Renjin and Java7, so I suspect the problem is more subtle.

Unfortunatfly ScriptEngineFactory swallows any exception thrown within getScriptEngine so perhaps you can try instatiating RenjinScrptEngine factory to see if you get any eceptions?

Best,
Alex

messages.subject: Re: Java8 dependency to use Renjin in my java application on Mac OS
parts:
Hi Johan,

I just tried this using Java 7, (fixed a minor bug in the process, git pull), and the ScriptEngine thing works well. 
Attached is a small maven project that uses the script engine, it has a dependency on the current Renjin snapshot.

After doing a "mvn install" for Renjin, you can run the example using

mvn compile exec:java -Dexec.mainClass="testing.ScriptEngineTest"       

Hope this helps,

Hannes
